HomePage.title: One place for all your wishes
HomePage.description: Avoid the question “What do you want for your birthday?” — create your own wishlist and share it with friends so they know what you really want as a gift. Perfect for everything from newborn birthdays to books and home items.
HomePage.board1description: New running shoes for the season, resistance bands upgrade, and that sleek fitness watch I've been eyeing.
HomePage.board2description: Kayaking trip gear, hiking backpack, and tickets for the next cycling marathon.
HomePage.board3description: A new lens for my camera, sketchbook for ideas, and a pottery class I've been meaning to try.
HomePage.concreteWishDescription: Keep track of the exact items or experiences you'd love to receive
HomePage.wishBoardsDescription: Organise your wishes by theme and share them with family or friends.
HomePage.giftExchangeDescription: Create or join an event — a party, celebration, or special occasion — and link your wishes to it
HomePage.featuresTitle: Everything you need for your wishes
HomePage.featureOneTitle: On your phone and your computer
HomePage.featureOneDescription: Your wishlist should follow you everywhere. Whether you're browsing on your phone or researching on your computer, everything stays perfectly in sync.
HomePage.featureTwoTitle: Share it or keep it private
HomePage.featureTwoDescription: Some wishes are meant to be shared, others kept to yourself. Keep your lists private for personal ideas and surprises, or make them public when you're ready to share with friends and family.
HomePage.featureThreeDescription: No more copying and pasting links. When you find something you like online, just use your device's built-in Share option to send it straight to your wishlist.
HomePage.preFooterCTADescription: Dream big — save your wishes in one place, share them with family and friends, and let Noriuto help turn dreams into plans.

features.title: Everything your wishes need
features.concreteBody: Save the things or experiences you want — with a link, price and photo.
features.boardsBody: Group wishes by theme and share a board with family or friends.
features.exchangeBody: Secret Santa without the paper slips — create an occasion, draw names and swap gifts.

how.title: Three roles — one app
how.step1Title: Create a board and fill it with wishes
how.step1Body: Found something you like in any store? Share it to Noriuto — the wish, with its photo and price, lands on your board. Group by theme and share a single link.
how.step1P3: Private until you decide to share
how.step2Title: Open a board and reserve a gift
how.step2Body: Get a friend’s board link and instantly see what they really want. Reserve a gift — others see it’s taken, and the surprise stays intact.
how.step3Title: Secret Santa, without the paper slips
how.step3Body: Christmas, a birthday or an office party — create an occasion, invite everyone and the app draws who gifts whom. Each person sees their match and that person’s wishes.
how.step3P2: See who you drew, and their wishes
how.step3P3: Great for Christmas and any occasion
how.receiverHintSub: the wish is already on the board

tiles.syncBody: Your wishlist travels with you — everything syncs automatically.
tiles.privacyBody: Private boards for ideas and surprises — share when you’re ready.
tiles.shareBody: Found something you like? “Share” — and it’s already on your board.

testimonials.title: They’re already dreaming with Noriuto
testimonials.quoteAusteja: I send my Noriuto board and know I’ll get something I actually want. No unnecessary gifts.
testimonials.quoteGintare: When the baby arrived, Noriuto let us simply share what we really need. Less chaos, more real joy.
testimonials.quoteArmandas: The gifts I actually want finally became reality. Small but long-awaited surprises.
testimonials.quoteTomas: It reminds me what I want — and better yet, what others want. No more “so what do I even buy?”
testimonials.quoteKornelija: Wishes don’t get forgotten — they get fulfilled. Thanks to others, or to myself.
